transcript.en: In the beginning of human civilization, there were no cities. There were just small settlements.
transcript.zh: 人类文明之初，没有城市。只有小定居点。

transcript.en: They grew with time and became villages and towns.
transcript.zh: 随着时间的推移，它们变成了村庄和城镇。

transcript.en: Then at a certain stage when the size became big enough, we call it a city.
transcript.zh: 然后到某个阶段，当规模变得足够大的时候，我们就称它为城市。

transcript.en: So, what about suburbs?
transcript.zh: 那么，郊区呢？

transcript.en: Generally speaking, a suburb is a mixed-use or residential area, existing as either part of a city or as a separate residential community within commuting distance of a city.
transcript.zh: 一般来说，郊区是一个混合用途或住宅的区域，作为城市的一部分或作为城市通勤距离内的单独住宅社区而存在。

transcript.en: Some small towns near a big city were absorbed by the city and became its suburbs.
transcript.zh: 大城市附近的一些小城镇被城市融合，变成了城市的郊区。

transcript.en: Many labor workers such as carpenters, construction and factory workers live in the suburbs of the city.
transcript.zh: 许多劳工，如木匠、建筑工人和工厂工人住在城郊。

transcript.en: They usually have a lower income than the middle class and can’t afford the expensive houses or apartments in downtown area.
transcript.zh: 他们的收入通常低于中产阶级，买不起市中心昂贵的房子或公寓。

transcript.en: They live in the suburbs where the infrastructure is poor and the rent is low.
transcript.zh: 他们住在郊区，基础设施很差，租金也很低。

transcript.en: Interestingly, you may also see wealthy residents, most of whom are highly paid engineers, lawyers and doctors, enjoy their life in the suburbs.
transcript.zh: 有趣的是，你可能还会看到富裕的居民，其中大部分是高薪的工程师、律师和医生，他们也在郊区享受着他们的生活。

transcript.en: They live in the expensive neighborhoods which are located in the nicer areas.
transcript.zh: 他们住在位于较好位置的昂贵社区。

transcript.en: They usually have a very big house and a garden and a garage.
transcript.zh: 他们通常有一个很大的房子、一个花园和一个车库。

transcript.en: Traditionally, many people think that living in the suburbs is less convenient than living downtown where there were supermarkets, shopping malls and other facilities.
transcript.zh: 传统上，很多人认为住在郊区不如住在市中心方便，因为市中心有超市、商场等设施。

transcript.en: These facilities are not concentrated or even available in the suburbs.
transcript.zh: 在郊区，这些设施不集中，甚至没有。

transcript.en: Sometimes, people there have to travel for half an hour to get to the nearest market or grocery store.
transcript.zh: 有时，那里的人要半小时路程才能到达最近的市场或杂货店。

transcript.en: Actually, there are many good things about living in the suburbs.
transcript.zh: 其实，住在郊区有很多好处。

transcript.en: For instance, people pay relatively low taxes than people in the city, so they can have a more disposable income.
transcript.zh: 比如，人们交的税比城里人低，所以他们可以有更多的可支配收入。

transcript.en: And food is cheaper than those in the cities.
transcript.zh: 而且食物比城市里的便宜。

transcript.en: Many people have noticed that vegetables and some kinds of fruits are usually produced in the suburbs or transported to the suburbs first before they reach the city.
transcript.zh: 很多人注意到，蔬菜和一些水果通常在郊区产出，或者在到达城市之前先运到郊区。

transcript.en: Because of lower taxes and other beneficial policies, it’s much easier to start one’s own business in the suburbs, for instance, open a café or set up a shop.
transcript.zh: 由于税收和其他优惠政策，在郊区创业更容易，例如开咖啡馆或开店。

transcript.en: That’s why we can see a lot of startups in the suburban region. It could also save a lot of money and effort.
transcript.zh: 这就是为什么我们可以在郊区看到很多创始公司。这样还可以省很多钱和精力。

transcript.en: Because of the ever-increasing population, now you can see many large-scale housing areas constructed in almost all city suburbs, as there is no room for new apartment buildings or houses in the cities.
transcript.zh: 由于人口的不断增加，现在几乎所有的城市郊区都可以看到许多大型住宅区，因为城市中已经没有新的公寓楼或房屋了。

transcript.en: Outside of many big cities, such as London, there are big residential areas.
transcript.zh: 很多大城市外围，比如伦敦，有很大的住宅区。

transcript.en: Also, the roads are designed and built much later so they are usually much wider than the roads downtown. This will provide greater mobility for suburban residents.
transcript.zh: 此外，由于道路的设计和建造要晚许多，因此它们通常比市中心的道路宽得多。这为郊区居民提供更大的出行便利性。

transcript.en: They can travel faster from one place to another since there are fewer traffic jams despite the growing number of automobiles on the roads.
transcript.zh: 他们可以更快地从一个地方到另一个地方，因为尽管道路上的汽车越来越多，但交通拥堵更少。

transcript.en: This is one of the reasons why more people are moving out of the city these years.
transcript.zh: 这也是这些年越来越多的人搬出城市的原因之一。

transcript.en: Yet, the suburbs are also facing some troubles in its development. Many suburbs are usually occupied by houses and residential areas.
transcript.zh: 然而，郊区的发展也面临着一些困难。许多郊区通常被房屋和住宅区占据。

transcript.en: As a result, there were not enough room for trade activities, even some supermarkets and small restaurants are suffering from this.
transcript.zh: 结果导致贸易活动空间不足，甚至一些超市和小餐馆都在面临这个困难。

transcript.en: People usually have to drive a car to the nearest grocery store.
transcript.zh: 人们通常不得不开车去最近的杂货店。

transcript.en: This warns the urban planning department to improve their work and have the vision to think ahead of time.
transcript.zh: 这警示城市规划部门要改进工作，要有超前思考的远见。

transcript.en: I think you might be interested in an interview that we did with some residents in the suburban area of London.
transcript.zh: 我想你可能会对我们对伦敦郊区的一些居民进行的采访感兴趣。

transcript.en: Their opinions can give us a picture of what suburban life is like compared to life downtown.
transcript.zh: 他们的意见可以让我们对郊区生活与市区生活进行对比。

transcript.en: Jack Simons is an office worker who lives in the western suburbs of London.
transcript.zh: 杰克·西蒙斯是一名住在伦敦西郊的上班族。

transcript.en: Through his observation, he thinks that although there are few public gyms or clubs and it’s not convenient to travel to the town for fitness classes, people in the suburbs actually do more exercise, such as jogging and swimming.
transcript.zh: 通过他的观察，他认为，虽然公共健身房或俱乐部很少，去城里上健身课也不方便，但郊区的人其实运动得更多，比如慢跑和游泳。

transcript.en: So, he concluded that the suburban folks enjoy a much healthier lifestyle compared with their city counterparts.
transcript.zh: 因此，他得出结论，与城市居民相比，郊区居民享有更健康的生活方式。

transcript.en: When we interviewed Ellen Simpson, a housewife who lives in the northern suburbs, she told us that living in the city center is a nightmare.
transcript.zh: 当我们采访住在北郊的家庭主妇艾伦·辛普森时，她告诉我们住在市中心简直是一场噩梦。

transcript.en: She said the city center is always congested with both cars and people and she could not stand it anymore.
transcript.zh: 她说市中心总是挤满了车和人，她受不了了。

transcript.en: Though many of her friends live in the city and people are generally friendly there, she still prefers to live in suburban areas and has adjusted to living here now.
transcript.zh: 虽然她的很多朋友都住在城里，那里的人也普遍都很友善，但她还是更喜欢住在郊区，现在已经适应了这里的生活。

transcript.en: We talked to an engineer named Robert Gregory who works downtown and lives in the suburbs.
transcript.zh: 我们采访了一位名叫罗伯特·格雷戈里的工程师，他在市中心工作，住在郊区。

transcript.en: In his opinion, the architectural style in the suburbs is quite the same as that in the city nowadays.
transcript.zh: 在他看来，现在郊区的建筑风格和城市里的建筑风格差不多。

transcript.en: Besides, people in the suburban area also pursue goals that are similar to the ones pursued by the people in the city.
transcript.zh: 此外，郊区的人们追求的目标也与城里人的追求相似。

transcript.en: Also, people in the suburbs don’t seem to be more satisfied with their life.
transcript.zh: 而且，郊区的人似乎对自己的生活非常满意。

transcript.en: Sarah Godfrey is an English teacher at a school in the city.
transcript.zh: 莎拉·戈弗雷是该市一所学校的英语老师。

transcript.en: According to her, people in cities are not necessarily less friendly than their counterparts in the suburbs but the latter always smile, they go to the parks and have gatherings more often.
transcript.zh: 据她说，城市里的人不一定不比郊区的人友好，但后者总是微笑，他们去公园和聚会的频率更高。

transcript.en: These activities are important in improving life quality and the level of happiness.
transcript.zh: 这些活动对提高生活质量和幸福水平很重要。
